paper.title: Finite-Time Analysis of Kernelised Contextual Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Kernelised (non-linear) contextual bandit with N actions and changing contexts
unmapped: Expected reward is linear in the RKHS feature map: E(r_{a,t}|x_{a,t}) = phi(x_{a,t})^T theta*, with theta* in H of unknown RKHS norm; each of N actions has a context x_{a,t} that changes over time
settings.definition_quote: For our non-linear contextual bandit model we assume the existence of a φ for which there exists a θ∗ ∈ H such that: E(ra,t | xa,t ) = φ(xa,t )T θ∗ . Taking a∗t := arg maxa∈A {φ(xa,t )T θ∗ } we can define the regret as before in (1).
